datasets.title: Asia–Africa World Development Indicators
datasets.description: Official annual country/sector context and historical trade proxies, 2015–2025.
datasets.source: World Bank WDI; upstream providers identified per indicator
datasets.license: World Bank open data terms (generally CC BY 4.0; source-specific exceptions may apply)

datasets.title: Historical product/service demand & supply references
datasets.description: Curated product records plus latest WDI food/agricultural and service trade proxies. Mixed units and periods; never sum as a single market total.
datasets.license: Source-specific terms apply; factual references with attribution

datasets.title: Official-source provider directory
datasets.description: Public profiles independently researched by AfriXAsia. Availability unverified.
datasets.license: Public factual references; source website rights retained

datasets.title: Additional Asia–Africa WDI market context
datasets.description: Eleven annual indicators for 2015–2025 beside the published 17-indicator snapshot: merchandise trade levels, manufactures shares, agriculture, manufacturing and services value added, inflation, the official exchange rate, electricity access, and mobile subscriptions. Null source values are omitted.
datasets.license: World Bank open data terms (generally CC BY 4.0; source-specific exceptions may apply)

datasets.title: Africa–Asia merchandise export corridors
datasets.description: UN Comtrade bilateral goods exports for HS 0901, 0902, 1801, 1006, 080131, 1511, 5201 and 6109. Rows below USD 1 million are omitted. A missing pair is not zero trade.
datasets.frequency: Annual; collection resumes from the last finished reporter-year

fields.country: ISO3 in WDI observations; country names in curated records
fields.value: Original numeric source value; no missing-to-zero conversion
fields.unit: Indicator-specific; retained in API and exports

citation: World Bank, World Development Indicators. Retrieved 2026-10-10. Curated by AfriXAsia, snapshot 2026-10-10-wdi-v1.
